Manhattan Project / Oppenheimer / Los Alamos / FDR / Potsdam / Trinity test / Enola Gay / Tibbets / Groves / Stimson / Okinawa / Little Boy / Fat Man / 116 days / crisis decision-making / leadership inheritance / nuclear ethics / Operation Silverplate.
